verification.summary: Only the named source snapshots drifted. Existing contact, fan-default and final-statistics contracts retain their reviewed source scope. New count behavior and explicit serialization differences are captured by durable evidence; no old benchmark is relabeled as a current result.

conclusion: A locally collision-safe CONTACT_TO_MODEL candidate does not establish a flat model landing. Only avoidance-classified gracious candidates and build-plate candidates set to_model_gracious during organic tip initialization. Otherwise ordinary collision-based model-resting propagation must remain available for inclined surfaces; forcing flat-landing avoidance can delete valid tips and emit failed influence-area expansion warnings. Preserve normal branch clearances and the separate local contact-footprint exception. Current endpoint fixes additionally lower the independent bed-support layer only when necessary to preserve a nearby exact contact within minimum thickness constraints. Historical Benchy timing and path-comparison observations are not current-build guarantees. The generic G-code layer-count fix filters empty export records and shares one plan for counting and generation. Support geometry and contact-height algorithms are unchanged, and current support and belt regressions pass.
